description: Defines the 'Process' class and nested 'Options' class for process management, including launching, killing, and I/O handling, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Encapsulates process creation, management, and I/O operations with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: Process::Options
classes.description: Handles command-line options and argument construction for process execution.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the process is currently active.

methods.name: HasConnector
methods.description: Indicates if the process has an I/O connector.

methods.name: IsKilled
methods.description: Checks if the process was killed.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the process has terminated.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Writes data to the process input (Windows and POSIX implementations).

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Reads data from the process output (Windows and POSIX implementations).

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Reads data from the process error output (Windows and POSIX implementations).

methods.name: Launch
methods.description: Starts the process with specified options, manages pipes and process creation.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Terminates the process, optionally with a hard kill.

methods.name: WaitProcessCompleted
methods.description: Waits for the process to complete within a specified timeout.
